provenance: Editorial research ledger; original community evidence remains in the private working record. This is not a live Reddit crawl.

items.title: 编程任务对应的额度、重置周期与续费选择
items.pain: 已复核两条原始讨论正文：编程任务的工具分配和配额消耗可预测性存在困惑；显示的相对时间不足以确认绝对发布日期。
items.task: 核对现有选型页的新旧订阅分组、额度单位与重置规则；先确认官方方案适用人群，再补具体事实缺口。
acceptance: 保留来源日期、单位与周期；未知值不能写成零或无限。
同一帖子重复缓存只计一个来源；免费意图不当作付费需求。
先复现现有路径缺口，再决定最小改动；沿用现有完成/导出计量。
items.commercial_hypothesis: 帮助正在续费或迁移的开发者完成具体工具决策；本轮没有 BPJ 付款证据。
items.counter_evidence: 原帖回复有相反体验；现有 BPJ 选型器已覆盖多数决策。官方方案可能区分新旧订阅，不能把旧套餐一律判错或批量覆盖。

verification.site_fit: verified: the existing Cursor detail and upgrade paths still present legacy plans as current, while the official current and legacy documentation now separates the X Subscription from still-working legacy subscriptions
verification.outcome: authorize a bounded correction inside the existing Cursor decision path; do not create a new selector
verification.note: The two community sources still have unknown absolute publication dates and are not counted as two current buyers or payment evidence. Current official product documentation reproduces the site information gap but is not treated as a new user-demand source.

release.acceptance: Current-main guard, focused bilingual data/render checks, production browser checks, GA4 coverage, canonical/SEO/i18n build checks and Cloudflare deployment passed.
release.limitations: Local browser binary download was unavailable; the production CI browser gate passed. The broad unrelated vendor-link crawl was not completed. Customer completion, registration, payment and revenue effects remain unknown.

items.title: 试用、取消与续费条件核对
items.pain: 订阅前的试用能力和退出条件不清楚；目前仅有日期未知的缓存线索。
items.task: 核验官方试用、退款和取消规则，与现有 BPJ 数据字段比对后决定是否补齐。
acceptance: 只使用厂商当日官方条款；区分免费层、试用与退款。
不得承诺没有官方保证的退款或精确剩余额度。
保留现有匿名选型入口，不新增付费墙或支付方案。
items.commercial_hypothesis: 缩短已有 AI 工具选型流程；联盟资格和收入另行核验。
items.counter_evidence: 可能只需要链接官方帮助页，不需要新工具。

verification.site_fit: verified engineering information defect: the existing Claude entry still says the official source returned 403 and leaves refund terms unverified, while current first-party Claude pricing and help pages now publish the free-plan, cancellation and refund boundaries
verification.outcome: authorize a bounded factual correction inside the existing bilingual coding-access path; do not create a new trial tool or treat the cached community lead as confirmed demand
verification.note: BPJ-T1 remains an unread supplier cache with unknown publication date and is not counted as current demand, a buyer or payment evidence. The official documentation independently reproduces a stale-information defect in the existing directory.
verification.counter_evidence: Claude already offers a free plan and official help pages, so a separate trial selector would duplicate the provider and BPJ's existing directory. Refund eligibility varies by law and purchase channel; the site must not promise a universal refund.

experiment.baseline: Claude was marked pending; the card said the source returned 403 and told users to verify refunds themselves.
experiment.candidate: The existing bilingual card now distinguishes Free access from a standing Pro trial, states default renewal and cancellation timing, preserves regional/channel-specific refund limits, and links four dated first-party references.
experiment.regression: Bilingual build, focused coding-access data/render/privacy checks, 16 pain-radar tests, evolution invariants, 36 release-input guard tests, nine GA4 coverage tests and generated-site GA4 coverage passed.
experiment.pending: The production CI browser, full site, current-main, Cloudflare deployment and live gates passed. The local Playwright browser binary remained unavailable. Customer completion, registration, payment and revenue effects are unknown.

release.acceptance: Focused bilingual data/render/privacy checks, 16 pain-radar tests, evolution invariants, 36 current-main release-input guard tests, nine GA4 coverage tests and generated-site GA4 coverage passed locally. Production CI then passed the full build, real-browser gates, GA4 consent and fixed-action checks, current-main guard, Cloudflare deployment, published coding-access check and changed-only IndexNow step; both live language routes were inspected after deployment.
release.limitations: The workflow connector confirmed a successful deployment but did not expose a deployment completion timestamp, so deployed_at remains unknown. BPJ-T1 remains an unread supplier cache with unknown publication date and is not confirmed demand, a buyer or payment evidence. No purchase, cancellation or refund was executed. The unrelated broad vendor-link crawl was not completed. Customer completion, reuse, registration, payment and revenue effects remain unknown.

items.title: AI 结论缺少业务背景与来源支撑
items.pain: 公开讨论反映 AI 对缺少上下文的问题给出肯定解释；与 Jarvis 的来源检查有相邻适配，尚未证明是本站用户需求。
items.task: 用合成任务复核现有 Jarvis 的证据与不确定性输出；先确认是否存在可复现缺口。
acceptance: 保留业务前提、来源日期和未知项；引用格式通过不等于结论被证明。
用冻结的合成任务比较改前改后；不读取客户任务正文。
不改变电商周报导师的单一受众，不增加模型额度或收费承诺。
items.commercial_hypothesis: 提高已有研究任务的可复核性与复用价值；付费意愿未知。
items.counter_evidence: 来源为代理商报告语境，与 AGI 使用者适配需要单独验证；一个帖子不是普遍需求。

verification.site_fit: verified engineering defect: Jarvis ordinary-source ranking serializes entire records, so source IDs, URLs, dates and other metadata can create false relevance matches; a frozen synthetic check passes 3 of 12 cases before correction
verification.outcome: authorize a bounded deterministic relevance correction in the existing Jarvis path; the source gate still blocks treating this as a confirmed pain-point extension
verification.note: The one community source is adjacent agency context, not repeat demand, a buyer or payment evidence. This work corrects an independently reproduced product defect and does not claim model-quality improvement.

experiment.candidate: 12/12 frozen synthetic relevance cases; representative English and Chinese catalog queries retained the intended record
experiment.regression: 137 Jarvis unit, security, membership, screening and handoff checks passed locally; release-safety, radar, hreflang and breadcrumb checks passed
experiment.pending: The local browser binary was unavailable, so production browser and full generated-site checks remain release gates in CI.

release.acceptance: Frozen relevance improved from 3/12 to 12/12; pull-request evidence-contract and browser gates passed; the full current-main build, Jarvis privacy/membership lifecycle, GA4 coverage, SEO/GEO/i18n, all-site browser matrix, Cloudflare deployment and live smoke passed. Both live pages expose jarvis-20261102-25.
release.limitations: This deterministic correction does not understand synonyms or prove model-answer quality. One adjacent community source is not confirmed site demand. Customer completion, reuse, registration, payment and revenue effects remain unknown; no live AI task was created for this release.

items.title: 通用 AI 客户报告生成暂不扩建
items.pain: 报告整理费时，但通用生成、摘要与定时发送已有成熟替代。
items.task: 仅保存反证；不建立新的代理商报告站或改变现有导师定位。
acceptance: 重新投入需同类买家重复缺口、明确现有替代失效与可交付结果。
items.commercial_hypothesis: 报告收尾与核对仍是假设，本轮不售卖。
items.counter_evidence: Swydo、AgencyAnalytics 与 Whatagraph 已覆盖通用 AI 报告；存在满意用户反证。
